plugins.description: Judaro — a client plugin for the hosted Judaro MCP server to improve reliability when working with Claude. Discovers and loads entitlement-gated Israeli-legal skills, playbooks, knowledge, and references from the central server. Ships no content; content updates propagate from the server.
